notes_es: v2.4 - NOVEDAD PRINCIPAL: ahora TRADE SENTINEL opera en Interactive Brokers y puedes generar tu robot para IB (futuros como Nasdaq MNQ), ademas de cripto: selector cripto/IB al generar el robot, conexion por IB Gateway (sin API keys), prueba de conexion desde la app, horario de mercado CME automatico con rollover de contratos, y guia de despliegue incluida (carpeta IB). Cripto: el robot informa en Telegram las comisiones REALES del exchange (antes podia mostrar 0 en MEXC), con PnL neto exacto; entrada mas rapida y precisa. Backtest con desglose por mecanismo de salida. Guia de IB actualizada: arranque automatico del Gateway tras reinicios del servidor y que ocurre al abrir la app movil de IBKR.
notes_en: v2.4 - MAIN NEW FEATURE: TRADE SENTINEL now trades on Interactive Brokers and you can generate your IB robot (futures like Nasdaq MNQ), in addition to crypto: crypto/IB selector when generating the robot, IB Gateway connection (no API keys), connection test from the app, automatic CME market hours with contract rollover, and a deployment guide included (IB folder). Crypto: the robot now reports the REAL exchange fees on Telegram (it could previously show 0 on MEXC), with exact net PnL; faster, more accurate entries. Backtest with per-exit-mechanism breakdown. IB guide updated: automatic Gateway startup after server reboots and what happens when you open the IBKR mobile app.
